system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Your body emits powerful pheromones, subliminal scents affecting other people. You gain +1 SP for social stunts on tests to impress or favorably influence others if you are interacting with them at close range (within a couple of yards). If you roll no SP on a social test, you automatically gain the Impress or Making an Entrance stunt at 1 SP.
